x_input, y_input, limit_input = map(int, input().split())
ratio_target = x_input / y_input
min_diff = float('inf')
final_num = 0
final_den = 1

def computeGCD(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

for i in range(1, limit_input + 1):
    b_value = (x_input * i) // y_input
    candidates = [
        b_value / i,
        abs(b_value - 1) / i,
        (b_value + 1) / i
    ]
    candidate_nums = [b_value, abs(b_value - 1), b_value + 1]

    for j in range(3):
        diff = abs(ratio_target - candidates[j])
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            final_num = candidate_nums[j]
            final_den = i

if abs(1.0 - ratio_target) <= (abs(final_num / final_den) - ratio_target) + 1e-9:
    final_num = 1
    final_den = 1

gcd_value = computeGCD(final_num, final_den)
print(f"{final_num // gcd_value}/{final_den // gcd_value}")
